scope: Paper-specified SPSDO component diagnostic; declared PHHC interpretation; no full PPEO evolutionary search or ensemble reproduction.

synthetic_law.sampling: uniform area: radius sqrt(U), uniform angle
synthetic_law.note: Class and subgroup proportions fixed across independent fit/validation/test draws. True subgroup IDs and exact supports are evaluator-only. Normalized local overlap is independent of elongation/orientation; non-corresponding cross-class supports must be checked before fitting.

reference.partition: paper Algorithm1 PHHC interpretation; nearest-centroid ties smallest index; original-only top-down impurity splitting and F1 rollback; connected components of Eqs4/7 in majority-labelled clusters are small prototypes
reference.allocation: fixed inverse-prototype-size weights; gap 384; shared prototype draw then uniform original anchor draw; no evolutionary optimization
reference.large_generation: one common original-only within-prototype SMOTE array reused identically by six geometry methods; k=min(floor(sqrt(n)),n-1); singleton copy
reference.ros: duplicate anchors using same complete frozen quotas

shape.estimator: sklearn.covariance.LedoitWolf on original standardized fitting rows within prototype
shape.normalization: C *= d / trace(C); symmetric positive-definite square root L (L L^T = C)
shape.fallback: duplicate for n < max(3,d+1), deficient centered rank, non-positive trace, or failed factorization; record every reason and affected row count
shape.conflicting_labels: exact coincident opposite-label coordinates: preserve quota by flagged duplication; no strict margin certificate

threshold_rule: validation only; lowest distinct score threshold with empirical majority FPR <= .05, or nextafter(max_score,+inf); predictions score>=threshold
sphere_selection: maximize overall validation minority recall at its validation-selected threshold; tie by validation AP then larger scale; reuse selected fitted model (no refit); no subgroup IDs in selection
pairing: compare identical dataset blocks, fitting observations, preprocessing, reference assignments, quotas and classifier settings; only small-prototype generation changes except explicit ROS/NORES controls

decision_gate.purpose: conservative diagnostic gate for whether a complete proposal is justified, not a significance test or superiority claim
all_required: mean paired macro-rare-recall gain >= 0.03 against EACH primary comparator
mean achieved FPR increase <= 0.01 against EACH primary comparator
mean AP loss <= 0.01 against EACH primary comparator
macro-rare-recall nonnegative paired gain in at least 6 of 8 blocks against EACH primary comparator
lower mean small-branch outside-minority-support rate than BOTH spsdo and unscreened ellipsoid
diagnostic includes nonzero rare-subgroup small-branch generation; geometric and count assertions pass
decision_gate.if_fail: Do not recommend developing a full extension; retain as negative/inconclusive mechanism diagnostic and specify one justified next action. Do not tune protocol after test inspection.

reporting: One independent draw per condition, no replicated inference; paired deltas and condition rows, no significance or general-superiority claims. Timing descriptive. Failure/unavailable records retained. No unpublished data/individual jobs/papers in Git; only new code/tests, protocol, provenance and aggregate condition-level evidence.
missing_starting_evidence: Question_B_Paper_Review_and_Extension.md not found in checkout, fetched refs, Git path history, or uploaded files at initial inspection; requested branch/path/text asynchronously. Do not infer its contents or reopen unknown closed candidates.
